data.title: Add docket tree <id> command for dependency visualization
data.body:
Show the dependency tree rooted at a specific bug, displaying both ancestors (what blocks it) and descendants (what it blocks).

## Basic output format

```
$ docket tree abc1

abc1: Implement user auth [Approved, P1]
│
├── Blocked by:
│   ├── def2: Set up database schema [InProgress, P2]
│   │   └── ghi3: Choose database engine [Done] ✓
│   └── jkl4: Design API endpoints [Approved, P2]
│
└── Blocks:
    ├── mno5: Add login page [Draft, P2]
    │   └── pqr6: Add OAuth support [Draft, P3]
    └── stu7: Add session management [Approved, P1]
```

## Options to consider

- `--up` / `--down` — Show only ancestors or descendants
- `--depth N` — Limit recursion depth
- `--compact` — One line per bug

## Implementation notes

- Cycle detection needed (warn but still display)
- Handle missing/deleted bug references gracefully
- Color coding: Done=green, InProgress=blue, blocked=yellow

Show the dependency tree rooted at a specific bug, displaying both ancestors (what blocks it) and descendants (what it blocks).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Basic `docket tree <id>` command shows dependency relationships
- [x] Shows "Blocked by" section with ancestor dependencies
- [x] Shows "Blocks" section with descendant dependencies  
- [x] `--up` flag shows only ancestors
- [x] `--down` flag shows only descendants
- [x] `--depth N` limits recursion depth
- [x] Cycle detection warns but continues display
- [x] Missing/deleted bug references handled gracefully
- [x] Color coding matches existing graph.rs patterns

## Basic output format

```
$ docket tree abc1

abc1: Implement user auth [Approved, P1]
│
├── Blocked by:
│   ├── def2: Set up database schema [InProgress, P2]
│   │   └── ghi3: Choose database engine [Done] ✓
│   └── jkl4: Design API endpoints [Approved, P2]
│
└── Blocks:
    ├── mno5: Add login page [Draft, P2]
    │   └── pqr6: Add OAuth support [Draft, P3]
    └── stu7: Add session management [Approved, P1]
```

## Options implemented

- `--up` — Show only ancestors (what blocks this change)
- `--down` — Show only descendants (what this change blocks)
- `--depth N` — Limit recursion depth

## Implementation notes

- Cycle detection: Shows "(cycle)" in red and stops recursion
- Missing bugs: Shows "(not found)" in red
- Color coding: Done=green/blue, InProgress=yellow, Review=magenta, Approved=green, Blocked=red, Draft=dimmed

## Log

- 2026-01-25: Implemented tree command with --up, --down, --depth flags. Added cycle detection and graceful error handling. All tests pass.
